reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getAverageFillCategories and its sign from averageToBudgetAmount, and goes through setBudget/batchMessages like the other month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Only the per-category loop skeleton mirrors set3MonthAvg, and reading 'sum-amount-' from the previous month's sheet is the same one-line access getCategoryAverage uses; no rule is copied.

placement.why: The action lives in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the action, its registration and one test are added.

maintainability.why: Short, consistent with set3MonthAvg, and changes to category selection or sign handling flow through the shared helpers automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getAverageFillCategories, averageToBudgetAmount, setBudget and getSheetValue.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied in reshaped form; the shared selection and sign helpers are called.
